label: TP
reason: User input flows directly from request parameter to bar via a chain of transformations (StringBuilder, HashMap, substring, Base64 round-trip, split). The Base64 encode/decode preserves all characters except whitespace which is stripped by split(' ')[0]. However, XSS payloads like '<script>' contain no spaces and survive intact. The final bar is written to response.getWriter().format(bar, obj), allowing unescaped script tags to render in HTML context, constituting a genuine XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User param flows through doSomething to bar, then to response.getWriter().format(bar, obj) without HTML escaping.
